skills.description: This skill should be used when a user wants to plan a self-driving (road trip) itinerary in Xinjiang (新疆), especially when they provide their trip window (dates) and desired destinations and want an interactive, customized day-by-day plan. It turns the user's time plus desired destinations into a complete route with drive times, overnight towns, hotel picks, a booking/reservation timeline, cost estimates, and a route map. Trigger phrases include 新疆自驾游攻略, 新疆自驾规划, 新疆自驾路线设计, 新疆旅游路线, 北疆自驾, 南疆自驾, 新疆几日游怎么安排, 帮我设计新疆开车路线. Also trigger when the user already has a draft route and wants it refined, validated, or turned into a deliverable (HTML/PDF/MD).
